notes.title: Clouzy! Patch Notes - Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Today’s patch is just going to be a quick hotfix of a couple of important bugs.

[h2]Version 1.2.1 - Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the shader that appeared while pressing the interact button to pick up items showed artifact lines.
[*] Added a reinforcement to prevent an occasional bug where after the final cinematic the game would be just a black screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the summer event customization didn’t lock whenever creating a new save file.
[*] Fixed a bug in the crafting machine where the navigation between recipe pages didn’t work as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug where the summer event cinematic triggered a warn at the same time, limiting your visibility of the first seconds of the cinematic.
[*] Fixed a bug where the controls didn’t change dynamically between gamepad and keyboard while in the iClouzy.
[*] Fixed a bug where the summer event warn triggered when loading the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where food rewards from secondary quests didn’t cure the ailments they stated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the summer event notification continued showing up in the iClouzy even though the event was over.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Catatouille achievement was counting cooking attempts rather than successful meals created.
[*] Changed the way the “Game of Teas” achievement is obtained to avoid a bug where rarely the achievement couldn’t be unlocked.
[*] Fixed a bug where occasionally when sleeping in the bed inside the house, the wardrobe prompt would take priority over getting out of the bed.
[*] Fixed multiple bugs related to the orchard, including trees duplicating.
[*] Fixed a bug in the cloud status panel and the Nimbo to better update the status of the quests and clouds.
[*] Fixed a bug where some cinematics could be retriggered.
[/list]

As always thank you for your support and don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/TinymoonTeam]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@clouzygame?]Tiktok[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rqgB7z9]Discord [/url]for more regular updates.

notes.title: Clouzy Dev Diary 2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Today I wanted to talk a little bit about some of the new puzzles we've developed for Clouzy! lately. When we had the idea for these, we wanted to expand further on some areas of the map we thought could feel a bit empty or not as interesting, and so we created these to strengthen them.
First of all we have the Will o Wisps! These little cuties will disappear shortly after you touch them, revealing where their friends are. Find them all in time, and you'll be rewarded! Since they're quite small, they can be hard to see and may take a few tries to find them, so you may wanna take some time to explore the area beforehand. There's one more big secret about these little guys, but I'll leave that out to you to find it in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360660/b6086d1a992e6aabfe30016317e80c7029129b5c.gif[/img]
The second type of puzzles we're gonna talk about today are speed puzzles. You may remember the start point of these ones from this funny bug that we shared on [url=https://twitter.com/TinymoonTeam]Twitter[/url]: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360660/844f7221230460ea387f99b99c43530e66dac9d9.gif[/img]
Speed puzzles are a staple in platformer games, and so we decided to include them in Clouzy!, using ice trails that speed you up, and quicksand patches that slow you down.
And that's as much as we can talk about! The rest is up to you to find out!

If you want to join our community, you should join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rqgB7z9 ]Discord[/url]! Also follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@clouzygame?]TikTok[/url]!

notes.title: Clouzy Dev Diary 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We've been working hard on the game over the past couple months and wanted to give a quick dev update! Our past month has mostly been focused on porting, optimization, and bug fixing.

Starting off with optimization, when everyone plays a game the first and most important thing you want is for the game to run smoothly. That can be a bit of a challenge since you want everything to look really good and pretty, without making the game run at 10 FPS.
In an open-world game like Clouzy! that’s even harder, since sometimes from your point of view, you can be seeing a lot of different stuff at the same time. A lot of other technical boring aspects go into this, so to not get too deep into it, let’s just say that optimizing is making compromises. Making the game not have as much definition on the really far things where you can’t tell the difference so that the ones you have near look better and run smoothly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360660/327cd9b804efa9aad3a2f30374cbf6554cfa4a6e.png[/img]

A great example of this is The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, where you can see most of the most important landmarks from pretty much everywhere, without the game exploding of all the stuff it needs to load. But let’s be honest, Breath of the Wild looking so good on such a huge world is pretty much witchcraft lol.

The same goes for bug fixing! No one likes a game full of bugs, and although they still sometimes happen, we invest a lot of time into making sure things work as well as they can. This is another challenge, since most of the time, each time you fix a bug, another 10 new ones appear out of the blue. 
And so, after a lot of patience and a lot of wanting to smash your face against the keyboard, all of them are fixed! Until a new one reappears the next day, that is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360660/eecd85cbce1a6ea99e48d8dbd0b3f157f5d091cf.gif[/img]

notes.title: Clouzy! Publisher and Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Yeray from Tinymoon here! We have some exciting news to share! [b]Clouzy! is now being published by Freedom Games[/b] ( https://freedom.gg ). For those of you who may not know, a game publisher not only provides additional investment and funding for developing the game, but also takes care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages and the console release process, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be and provides us with the resources to do so.

With that being said, sadly, Clouzy!'s release date which was set for July this year will be delayed. We don’t have an exact date just yet. As soon as we do, we will announce it. Make sure to follow us here on Steam or on Twitter to make sure you’re one of the first to hear. Lots of things are going on in the background [b](like new customization, puzzles and more!)[/b] that we know will be for the best! We're looking forward to releasing Clouzy! and seeing you all play it. 

You may also be worried about horror stories of publishers ruining the vision of a game or forcing arbitrary restrictions on the dev team. For Freedom, that can’t be further from the reality we have experienced with them. Freedom has been an amazing partner to us, only enhancing and supporting our vision. We were very careful when considering which publishers offer to accept, and selected Freedom because they are committed to our vision of the game, and only want to see it reach its full potential as we see it. We maintain complete creative and development freedom, and Freedom (heh) wouldn’t have it any other way.
Thank you again for your understanding and for all the love and support you've given us since the beginning, it means the whole world to us. If you have any questions about it, feel free to join our Discord and we’d love to hear from you! Love you <3

notes.title: Clouzy! is getting delayed
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Yeray from Tinymoon here! Sadly, [b]Clouzy!'s release date[/b] which was set for [b]May this year[/b] will be delayed to [b]this summer.[/b]

We want to make sure that when the game comes out it [b]lives up to everyone's standards[/b], and it's in its best possible version, so we're taking some [b]extra time[/b] to be able to do that.

We hope you [b]understand the decision[/b] and [b]continue to support us[/b] just as much as you've always done.

Now, let's talk about this a little more in-depth, shall we?

Since we released the first demo for this project back in May last year, right after we ended university, the game has exponentially grown more and more, expanding and polishing a lot of the mechanics, gameplay, and art that were not the very best at first.

In these constant updates we've been doing to make sure the game's quality is up to standards, we've had to improve some old work and in most cases, throw it away and start over. This over time became a problem since we felt these were changes that needed to be done, however, they were taking time away from some of the new stuff that was on the line.

Adding up to that, this past 2020 was not an easy year for anyone in the world, and we're no exception. We've had to deal with some personal problems and mental health issues that affected us quite a lot and complicated this already tight deadline.

But this is meant to be a pity party! In the end, things have gotten better and we're back on track more excited than ever. We're looking forward to the day Clouzy! comes out and you can finally play it.

Thank you again for your understanding and for all the love you've given us, it means the whole world to us. Love you ❤.
